label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 21
title: MVP: email facility - pipeline/project status + alerts, configurable frequency
body: No email sender exists (only port_config SMTP ports for generated projects + a welcome-email.md template). Add a real email channel: per-user and per-project settings (enable + frequency: immediate / per-stage / daily / weekly digest). Content = current state, what's next, where in the pipeline, time per stage/agent, total time, plus failures/issues needing attention; properly formatted template with control links. Notify on any failure/issue or when attention/approval is needed. Extends core/notification_system.py (currently in-app only) with email + webhook channels.
